title: Shared Media viewer merges the session's current shared-media tab without checking its chat
trigger: Open the viewer from the Shared Media panel of chat A, then (notification click or deep link) another chat B becomes open and its shared media loads while the viewer is still up.
effect: sync_shared_media_viewer reads session.media.shared_media.tabs[tab] and merge_older takes items older than the first by message id; nothing compares shared_media.chat_id with the viewer's chat, so B's older items can be prepended to A's viewer.
fix: Store the chat in ViewerSource::SharedMedia{chat_id} and merge only when the session's shared_media.chat_id equals it.

title: Viewer delete availability uses the session's single message_menu_actions slot shared with the message menu and other windows' viewers
trigger: Open viewers in the main window and a chat window (or open a message context menu) so that fetch_message_menu_actions is asked for different messages.
effect: Each step asks fetch_message_menu_actions and the answer overwrites one Option<(chat, message, actions)>; the matching in viewer_delete_confirm keeps it correct but the other viewer's Delete button disappears until it steps again.
fix: Key the actions answer by (chat, message) in a small map, or per window view like WindowViews.

title: Picture-in-Picture of another account never sees its message deleted
trigger: Open PiP for a clip in account A, switch to account B, the clip's message is deleted in A.
effect: pip_message_deleted requires the on-screen session to be the link's account, so the window keeps playing a deleted message (header says it goes when the message is deleted). Only logout or lock closes it.
fix: Look the tombstone up in the link's own account (background client session) or let the account's deletion update close its links.

title: Speed and volume changes reach only the current window's viewer player
trigger: Two windows each show a playing viewer clip (main window and a chat window); change speed or volume in one.
effect: set_playback_speed and set_playback_volume write players.speed/volume app-wide but update only `self.viewer.player` of the window in scope, so the other window's clip keeps the old rate/volume while its slider/label reads the new value.
fix: Apply the app-wide value in one pass over every window's viewer (`in_every_window`).

title: "Share at" position stash is set even when the forward picker did not open or was toggled shut
trigger: Play a video, Share at 1:23 while the forward draft is on a different chat/topic or the message cannot be forwarded (begin_forward_one shows a note or toggles/closes the picker), then forward the same message by another route and use Copy link.
effect: share_at is set after begin_forward_one returns, so a refused or closed picker leaves it behind; the next Copy link for that message carries the old second until the viewer item is reset.
fix: Carry the position inside the forward stage (`ForwardStage::Selecting { draft, at: Option<Secs> }`) so it lives and dies with the picker.

title: Transcribe can be requested again before TDLib reports Pending
trigger: Press the transcribe button on a voice note twice in quick succession.
effect: request_transcription sets no in-flight marker; the button stays offered until updateMessageContent brings SpeechRecognition::Pending, so a second recognizeSpeech goes out (may spend the free speech trial).
fix: Track a Requested stage in SpeechRecognition (None, Requested, Pending, Text, Error) set when the request is sent.

title: Keep original aspect ratio uses the unrotated ratio after Rotate
trigger: Set-sticker editor with a wide image: press Rotate once (crop, base item and orientation turn), then toggle Keep original aspect ratio off and on again.
effect: toggle_keep_ratio rebuilds the crop from original_ratio as if the image were unturned, so the crop is the wrong shape (cuts picture or leaves padding) for a quarter-turned base.
fix: Model the crop as an enum CropMode::{Full, KeepRatio} and derive the rect from the current orientation at use, instead of storing keep_ratio beside a crop that rotate/flip rewrite by hand.

title: Rating box stays open with an empty body when the person's full info or rating goes away
trigger: Open the rating box, then the account's user_full_info for that person is dropped or has no rating (account switch back, info refresh without ratings).
effect: rating_box_target() returns None ('None closes it') but build_rating_box only draws an empty div with the Understood button; the is_open check (rating_box.is_some()) stays true, so an empty box remains until dismissed.
fix: Close the box (clear rating_box) when its target no longer resolves, or make is_open use rating_box_target().is_some().

title: Disable Sharing explainer counts as shown when it opens, even if dismissed without acting
trigger: Open a private chat profile More > Disable Sharing three times and press Esc each time.
effect: chat_prefs.disable_sharing_box_shown reaches 3 on opens, so the fourth use skips the explanation the user never read and acts at once (or sends them to the Premium preview).
fix: Increment the count when the box's button is pressed, not when it opens.

title: Retry on a failed profile chat list removes the Failed entry and ignores a synchronous send error
trigger: Open a profile whose groups-in-common or similar-channels fetch Failed, go offline so chats_path_active is false (or the sender is closed), press Retry.
effect: retry_profile_chats removes the (kind,key) entry first and drops the Err from fetch_*; the Retry row vanishes and nothing is loading, so the list never offers Retry again until the panel is reopened.
fix: Only remove the Failed entry after the fetch returned Ok(Some), or set it back to Failed on Err.

title: Personal photo picker overwrites whichever profile dialog is open when the answer arrives and leaves a box host set when cancelled
trigger: Edit contact > Set Photo (file picker opens, open_box(ProfilePanel) runs before profile_dialog is set); cancel the picker, or open Birthday meanwhile and then pick a file.
effect: On cancel hosts[ProfilePanel] stays Host::Asked with no dialog open; on a late pick the answer replaces profile_dialog unconditionally, dropping the dialog the user is typing in.
fix: Model the pick as ProfileDialog::PickingPhoto{user_id, mode} set before the prompt (and cancelled by the answer), and apply the answer only when that exact stage is still current.

title: Camera/save answers matched by a per-PhotoSources serial that is resolved through a moving photo_target()
trigger: Start the camera in the edit-profile dialog (serial 1), then an Edit-group box or New Group box with its own PhotoSources at serial 1 becomes the photo_target before the worker answers
effect: The late stream is attached to the other dialog's sources, or the answer is dropped and starting never clears
fix: Key the answer by (target owner, serial), or hold the answer task inside the PhotoSources that asked.

title: Taken photo preview is a newer frame than the saved JPEG
trigger: Click Take photo; while the JPEG saves the stream keeps drawing newer frames into camera.live; on completion camera.live is frozen as the shot
effect: Preview shows a different picture than the file that is cropped and uploaded
fix: Stop the stream (or freeze live) when Take photo is pressed, not when the save answers.

title: Slider quantisation can feed back into the colour while syncing controls
trigger: Type a hex colour; editor_sync_controls sets the three sliders to to_hsl(color); if a slider set_value emits Change with a stepped value, editor_slider_moved sees hsl differ and rewrites colour and hex
effect: Colour drifts by a rounding step and the hex field is rewritten under the caret
fix: Ignore slider events raised by programmatic set_value (a guard enum on the editor) or derive sliders from colour only.

title: Clicking a story tile does nothing when the story is not in the loaded stories
trigger: Gallery > Stories tab, click a tile whose story is not in session.stories (not yet fetched or expired). items.iter().position(..) is None and the function returns.
effect: A click that gives no feedback and no request for the story.
fix: Ask for the story (getStory) and show a loading state on the tile, or a note when it is gone.

title: Closing the Playlist page closes the whole gallery instead of going back to it
trigger: Open the gallery, open a profile's music Playlist page, press the playlist close button. It calls close_shared_media_ui, which closes shared_media entirely.
effect: The user lands on the bare chat with no gallery and the Media tab they were on is gone.
fix: Make the panel one enum Gallery(chat) / Playlist{user, back: Option<Gallery>} and let Playlist close pop to its back value.

title: Playlist rows decide 'playing' from a bare message id
trigger: Play a track in the Playlist page of user U in one chat, then open the same track's Playlist (same file id, so same playlist_message_id) while another chat is open. active compares playback.playing_audio with the synthetic id only, and toggle_audio_playback gets chat = open_chat or ChatId(0).
effect: A row can show playing/paused for playback that belongs to another chat key, and a press toggles the other chat's playback.
fix: Compare the full (ChatId, MessageId) owner key, as ChatMessage does, instead of the bare message id.

title: Playlist page shows 'Loading' forever when the playlist is not in the cache
trigger: open_playlist_ui sets playlist_user for a user whose playlist entry is missing (evicted, never fetched, fetch failed). empty is playlist.is_none(); the text picks PROFILE_LOADING and no fetch is asked here.
effect: A spinner-like text with nothing coming; only Close is a way out.
fix: Fetch<Playlist> per user (idle, loading, ready, failed) and ask for the playlist when the page opens.

title: Spoiler reveal fades are keyed by bare chat id and message id, not account
trigger: Reveal a spoiler in a chat open in two accounts, switch account within 200 ms.
effect: Cover fade state read by the other account's same chat/message key.
fix: RevealKey uses AccountChat/ChatMessage owner keys.

title: MessageName status head is keyed by the bare message id
trigger: Two chats show a premium sender status on messages with the same numeric id
effect: status_head hashes (surface, message_id, status_id) with no chat, so both views share one play head: a loop count spent in one chat is spent in the other
fix: Key the head by ChatMessage

title: A set sticker's New Sticker box can open with an older cover frame than the one chosen
trigger: Open the video editor for an owned sticker set, drag the cover head to a new frame and press Done before that frame's still cut lands.
effect: finish_set_video_editor takes editor.preview, which is the last landed still, not the still for edits.cover_ms. The cut in flight is then dropped because the editor is gone. The New Sticker box shows the previous cover frame, while the job encodes the chosen one.
fix: Keep the preview's frame time with it (preview: Option<(i64, PathBuf)>). When it does not match edits.cover_ms, the box asks for the cut itself instead of taking a stale picture.

title: The frame strip stays partly blank after an encode that started before the strip finished loading fails
trigger: Open Edit Video on a long video (or a video avatar) and press Done at once, while the strip frames are still being cut one by one. The encode fails.
effect: The strip loader checks editor.serial on each frame and stops when Done bumps it. When the encode fails, the editor stays open, but video_editor_reload_frames sees frames.len() == times.len() and the same width, so it treats the half-empty strip as kept and never reloads. The missing cells stay grey until the editor is reopened.
fix: Give the strip load its own stage (Loading { cancel, token } / Loaded / Stopped) keyed by its own token, not the editor serial, and reload when the stage is Stopped with frames missing.

title: clear_clip leaves speed_preview set, so a viewer whose speed drag was cut off keeps its controls up and shows a stale speed
trigger: In the media viewer, open the speed popover and drag its slider, then close the viewer (Esc, or the clip ends and the next opens) before the drag's Release reaches the slider. Open another video.
effect: speed_preview is cleared only by set_playback_speed (on Release or a preset). clear_clip resets seek_preview and volume_dragging but not speed_preview, so VideoControlsState::dragging() stays true: the controls never hide, and the speed label shows the preview instead of the real speed.
fix: One gesture value: enum ControlsDrag { None, Seek(f64), Volume, Speed(f64) }, reset whole by clear_clip.

title: A file player stuck in Opening asks for a display frame every vsync with no limit
trigger: Open a clip whose backend never reports ready nor failed (AVPlayer item stuck unknown, a decoder that hangs opening).
effect: awaiting counts as animating while state is Opening regardless of AWAIT_PICTURE, so the element requests the next frame every vsync for as long as the view is shown (CPU/battery).
fix: Bound the Opening wait too (an open deadline that fails the player), or let the 50 ms open poll drive redraws instead of per-vsync frame requests.

title: Player::seek clears `eof` but not `error`, so a clip that hit a decode error keeps reporting it after a seek that works
trigger: Play a video with a corrupt stretch so decoding fails mid-way (State::error set), then seek back to a good part (or let a looping inline clip loop).
effect: seek() resets eof, the queue and the clock, and the decode thread resumes decoding, but State::error stays Some; Player::error() and FfmpegBackend::status().failed keep saying the clip failed, so the transport stays Failed although pictures decode again.
fix: Hold the decode stage as one value: `enum Decoding { Running, Ended, Failed(String), Stopped }` that a seek replaces whole (Failed -> Running when the seek is accepted).
